about: How many people born 1930–2009 (one chart a day at 12:00 UT) have each aspect pattern or chart shape among the ten planets, Sun to Pluto (no angles, no Chiron, Lilith or nodes). Orbs: the five major aspects within 8° when the Sun or Moon is in the pair, 6° otherwise; the quincunx and the sesquiquadrate within 3°. grandTrine: three planets each trine the other two. tSquare: two in opposition, both square a third. grandCross: four planets in two oppositions, each square its neighbours. yod: two in sextile, both quincunx a third; boomerangYod: a yod with a fourth planet opposite its apex. kite: a grand trine with a fourth planet opposite one corner and sextile the other two. mysticRectangle: two oppositions joined by two sextiles and two trines. grandSextile: six planets, each sextile two and opposite one. minorGrandTrine: two in trine, both sextile a third. thorsHammer: two in square, both sesquiquadrate a third. cradle: two planets in opposition with two more between them on one side, in three sextiles. stellium3/4/5: at least 3, 4 or 5 of the ten in one sign. Chart shapes, from the smallest arc holding all ten: bundle (within 120°), bowl (within 180°, more than 120°), locomotive (within 240°, more than 180°); bucket: nine within 180° and the tenth outside. oneIn: about 1 person in N; inWords: the same said without a percentage (the nearest small fraction for the common ones).
